solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Brief arguments in trade buildings

definitions.meaning: short spats, words traded back and forth in anger
halls where commodities or shares are dealt, like a corn or stock market hall

explanation.surface: Traders bicker briefly inside their market halls.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses share the word: a quick sharp dispute, and a building where merchants meet to deal.

clue.text: Girl turning up in programmes

indicators.note: in a down clue turning up means the hidden letters read from bottom to top
in says the letters sit inside the word programmes

explanation.surface: A girl keeps appearing on television shows.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' hides AMME inside programmes; 'turning up' reverses it in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A common female first name, so it is an example of a girl's name.

clue.text: A hundred making a roundabout trip follow this on level ground

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred
a band or team travelling round venues is on tour

explanation.surface: A hundred hikers on a circular walk keep to the flat.
explanation.definitionFit: A line on a map joining points of equal height; walking along one keeps you at the same altitude.

clue.text: Scottish town, some holiday resort

indicators.note: some says only part of the words holiday resort is wanted, a run inside them

explanation.surface: A Scottish town that is something of a seaside holiday spot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'some' picks a run spanning holiday and resort. Ayr is a seaside town on the west coast of Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: A coastal town in south-west Scotland, so it is an example of a Scottish town.

clue.text: Girl on track in Irish city

parts.note: gal is an informal word for a girl
a track or path is a way

explanation.surface: A girl on a running track in a city in Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: A city on the west coast of Ireland, so it is an example of an Irish city.

clue.text: Chap is into bogus Asian religion

indicators.note: into says the man-and-is pair goes inside the word for bogus

parts.note: something bogus is a sham
a chap is a man

explanation.surface: A man has taken up a fake eastern faith.
explanation.definitionFit: A belief system of northern Asian peoples centred on spirit healers who enter trances.

clue.text: Island with crows regularly disappearing

indicators.note: every other letter of crows drops out, leaving the alternate ones

explanation.surface: An island where the crows keep vanishing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly disappearing' removes R and W from crows. Kos (also spelt Cos) is a Greek island.
explanation.definitionFit: A Greek island in the Dodecanese, so it is an example of an island.

clue.text: Manage to reduce one type of technology

parts.note: to reduce is to cut
IT is information technology

explanation.surface: Coping by trimming one branch of technology spending.
explanation.definitionFit: An informal idiom for being good enough or succeeding at a task, as in 'can he hack it'.

clue.text: Rose seen in the garden when there's been no rain?

definitions.text: Rose seen in the garden when there's been no rain?

parts.words: Rose seen in the garden when there's been no rain
parts.note: the rose is not a flower but the perforated nozzle on a watering can or hose, used to water plants in a dry spell

explanation.surface: A rose blooming in a garden during a drought.
explanation.walkthrough: Rose looks like the flower; it is the sprinkling head fitted to a watering can.
explanation.definitionFit: A watering-can rose scatters water in fine droplets, doing the job rain would.

clue.text: Strange marine life's origin in one sort of water

indicators.note: strange suggests the letters of marine are put into an odd order
origin says only the first letter of life's is taken

explanation.surface: Odd sea creatures turning up in a kind of water.
explanation.definitionFit: Water containing dissolved salts from a spring, often sold bottled, is one kind of water.

clue.text: Performer making some impact originally

indicators.note: making some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A performer who made something of a splash at first.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who plays roles on stage or screen is a type of performer.

clue.text: Knight getting on with companion, worker kept by friend in casual manner

parts.note: N is the chess notation for a knight
CH stands for Companion of Honour, a British order

indicators.note: kept by says the worker is held inside the friend

parts.note: a friend is an ally
an ant is the classic worker in crosswords

explanation.surface: A knight with his companion and a labourer looked after by a friend, all very relaxed.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something in an unconcerned, offhand way is doing it in a casual manner.

clue.text: Certain rabbis of celebrity status entering taxis

indicators.note: entering says the celebrity piece goes inside the taxis

parts.note: taxis are cabs
an A-list person is a top celebrity

explanation.surface: Famous rabbis climbing into cabs.
explanation.definitionFit: Students of the Kabbalah, Jewish mystical teaching, which some rabbis follow.

clue.text: Cleans a prison in London

definitions.meaning: Wormwood ... is a prison in west London, usually called just by its last word

explanation.surface: Someone does the cleaning at a London jail.
explanation.walkthrough: Wormwood Scrubs is a well-known men's prison in west London.
explanation.definitionFit: A verb for rubbing hard to clean, and the short name of a London jail.

clue.text: No longer drunk? Beers do dissipate!

indicators.note: dissipate says the letters of beers do scatter and regroup

explanation.surface: Is someone sober now? The beers are wearing off.
explanation.definitionFit: Having been made sober again, so no longer intoxicated.

clue.text: Smile weakly as less sophisticated learner getting left out

indicators.note: getting left out says the learner letter is dropped from the word

parts.note: less sophisticated means simpler
L is the learner plate abbreviation

explanation.surface: A naive learner, excluded, gives a feeble smile.
explanation.definitionFit: To smile in a silly, affected or coy way is to smile weakly.

clue.text: Quietly coming to conclusion or remaining undecided?

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction for quietly
a conclusion is an ending

explanation.surface: Is a matter quietly reaching its close, or still unsettled?
explanation.definitionFit: A matter awaiting a decision or settlement is still open, not yet resolved.

clue.text: Group of seven in gym detained by principal

indicators.note: detained by says the gym piece is held inside the principal

parts.note: a school principal is the head
PT is physical training, school gym lessons

explanation.surface: Seven pupils kept behind in gym by the headteacher.
explanation.definitionFit: From Greek hepta, seven: a set or series of seven things.

clue.text: Confusion of more savage fellows in risky enterprise

indicators.note: in says the savage fellows go inside the risky enterprise

parts.note: a bet is a gamble, a risky undertaking
more savage means wilder
fellows are men

explanation.surface: Chaos as fiercer men join a dangerous venture.
explanation.definitionFit: A state of being utterly puzzled or perplexed, which is confusion.

clue.text: Place for Humpty, ultimately silly fool

parts.note: in the nursery rhyme Humpty Dumpty sat on a wall

indicators.note: ultimately says only the last letter of silly is taken

explanation.surface: Humpty Dumpty, sitting on his wall, ends up a silly fool.
explanation.walkthrough: Wally is British slang for a foolish person.
explanation.definitionFit: British informal slang for a silly or inept person, so a synonym for fool.

clue.text: Left-winger beginning to talk rubbish

indicators.note: beginning to says only the first letter of talk is taken

parts.note: rubbish or nonsense is rot

explanation.surface: A left-wing activist starts to spout nonsense.
explanation.definitionFit: Short informal word for a Trotskyist, a follower of Leon Trotsky, hence a radical leftist.

clue.text: Keeps turning over lists

definitions.meaning: goes on revolving, tumbling over and over
registers or official records of names

explanation.definitionFit: A verb for repeatedly revolving, and a noun for registers of names, as in electoral records.

clue.text: Greek character in row is more under the influence

indicators.note: in says the Greek letter goes inside the row

parts.note: a tier is a row, as of seats
psi is a letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A Greek fellow in a fight is getting drunker.
explanation.walkthrough: Character looks like a person and row like a quarrel; they are a letter and a tier of seats.
explanation.definitionFit: Comparative of tipsy, slightly drunk, so further under the influence of alcohol.

clue.text: Chum is sickly looking, without energy

indicators.note: without says the energy letter is removed

parts.note: someone sickly looking is pale
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A friend looks unwell and lacks any energy.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are informal words for a friend or mate.

clue.text: Fish deprived of oxygen out of water

indicators.note: deprived of says the oxygen letter is taken away

parts.note: a dory is a sea fish, as in John Dory
O is the chemical symbol for oxygen

explanation.surface: A fish without oxygen, stranded out of water.
explanation.definitionFit: Something not wet or immersed is free of moisture.

clue.text: One type of lamp is put back by entrance

indicators.note: put back says the word is is reversed

parts.note: to entrance, stress on the second syllable, is to delight

explanation.surface: A lamp is moved back beside the doorway.
explanation.walkthrough: 'entrance' looks like a doorway noun; it is the verb meaning to enchant.
explanation.definitionFit: A small lamp on a vehicle, at the front edge, is one kind of lamp.
